The '''Rbollea system''' was located in the [[Interior Region]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Tinta system/Legends|Tinta system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Rbollea [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the substance known as [[Rbollean petal-oil]].<ref name="DN">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Rbollean petal-oil]]|system=Rbollea [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rbollea system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
